summary: Every legal input has exactly four replaceable digit positions and represents a subset of the fixed 1,440-time 24-hour clock domain, so no honest asymptotic scaling range exists.

workload_bound.source_constraint: time has fixed length five and valid completions range only from 00:00 through 23:59

replacement_checks.evidence: The Accepted source performs a fixed number of comparisons over four digit positions and multiplies the independent hour and minute counts.
Regression derives every wildcard pattern obtainable from all 1,440 valid concrete times and verifies its exact completion count.
